user.title: Connect your Codex account
user.description:
On the machine where you use the Codex CLI, run `codex login` if you haven't, then paste the full contents of `~/.codex/auth.json` below.

Home Assistant keeps its own copy of the tokens and refreshes them automatically.

If Home Assistant cannot reach OpenAI directly, set an outbound proxy (http://host:port) — it is used immediately for this validation.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Codex Usage
reauth_confirm.description: The stored token no longer works. Paste the current contents of `~/.codex/auth.json` again (run `codex login` first if needed).

error.invalid_auth_json: Could not parse the pasted content. It must be the JSON from ~/.codex/auth.json, containing tokens.access_token and tokens.refresh_token.
error.cannot_connect: The usage API rejected these credentials. Make sure the auth.json is fresh (log in again with `codex login`).
error.invalid_proxy: Proxy URL must start with http:// (aiohttp tunnels HTTPS via CONNECT and does not accept https:// proxies).

abort.already_configured: This Codex account is already configured
